description: Manifest of env vars required by a HealthLog production deployment. Used by `pnpm check-env` to catch missing/empty vars BEFORE a deploy ships. v1.4.42 W6 — born out of the v1.4.40 AP-2 .p8 install gap that shipped silently for 3 days.

groups.name: Core
groups.description: Database, app URL, encryption keys. The app refuses to boot without these.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.purpose: Postgres connection string. App boot fails if missing.

variables.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
variables.purpose: Database password for the bundled `db` service in docker-compose.yml.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
variables.purpose: Public URL embedded in OAuth redirects, webhook callbacks, APNs deep-links.

variables.name: APP_URL
variables.purpose: Server-side mirror of NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL; used by background workers.

variables.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.purpose: AES-256-GCM key for at-rest encryption of provider tokens. 64 hex chars (32 bytes). Required unless ENCRYPTION_KEYS is set.

variables.name: API_TOKEN_HMAC_KEY
variables.purpose: HMAC-SHA256 key for hashing external Bearer tokens AND web session cookies. 64 hex chars. Rotating it signs every browser session out on top of invalidating every issued token.

groups.name: Withings OAuth
groups.description: Withings API credentials are entered per user in Settings → Integrations (no env-var path). Only the webhook shared secret is operator-level.

variables.name: WITHINGS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.purpose: Random secret carried as a path segment in the Withings webhook callback URL. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

groups.name: Polar OAuth
groups.description: Required to enable the Polar AccessLink integration. App boots without these but the Polar connect button stays disabled. Register an app at https://admin.polaraccesslink.com and set the redirect URI to ${NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/api/polar/callback.

variables.name: POLAR_CLIENT_ID
variables.purpose: Polar AccessLink OAuth client id.

variables.name: POLAR_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.purpose: Polar AccessLink OAuth client secret.

groups.name: Oura OAuth
groups.description: Required to enable the Oura Cloud v2 integration. App boots without these but the Oura connect button stays disabled. Register an app at https://cloud.ouraring.com/oauth/applications and set the redirect URI to ${NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/api/oura/callback.

variables.name: OURA_CLIENT_ID
variables.purpose: Oura Cloud OAuth client id.

variables.name: OURA_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.purpose: Oura Cloud OAuth client secret.

groups.name: OIDC SSO login
groups.description: Required to enable SSO login against a self-hosted identity provider (Authentik, Keycloak, Authelia, Google Workspace, etc.). App boots without these but the login page's SSO button stays hidden. Register a confidential client with redirect URI ${NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/api/auth/oidc/callback.

variables.name: OIDC_ISSUER_URL
variables.purpose: OIDC provider issuer URL (discovery doc served at <issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration).

variables.name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
variables.purpose: OIDC confidential client id.

variables.name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.purpose: OIDC confidential client secret.

groups.name: OIDC SSO options
groups.description: Optional tuning for an enabled OIDC provider. Each stands alone (deliberately NOT allOrNone — any subset is valid) and each has a safe default when unset.

variables.name: OIDC_SCOPES
variables.purpose: Space-separated scopes requested at authorization. Default: "openid email profile".

variables.name: OIDC_BUTTON_LABEL
variables.purpose: Label on the login page's SSO button. Default: "Single Sign-On".

variables.name: OIDC_ONLY
variables.purpose: "true" disables password/passkey login server-side (only effective when the OIDC provider group is fully configured). Default: additive login. Locks the native iOS app out of sign-in.

groups.name: AI Provider
groups.description: Optional runtime policy and output tuning for user-configured AI providers. Each variable stands alone and has a safe default when unset.

variables.name: ALLOW_LOCAL_AI_PRIVATE_HOSTS
variables.purpose: Local-AI SSRF opt-in. Unset rejects private/internal hosts; set an exact comma-separated host allowlist or "true" to allow any private host.

variables.name: INSIGHTS_MAX_TOKENS
variables.purpose: Daily-briefing output-token ceiling. Default 2500, clamped to 500-8000.

variables.name: INSIGHTS_RATE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR
variables.purpose: Per-user hourly ceiling for POST /api/insights/generate. Default 10; values below 1 fall back to the default.

variables.name: DOCUMENT_AI_LIMIT_PER_HOUR
variables.purpose: Per-user hourly ceiling for the document-AI actions (read/index, extract, suggest, summarise share one bucket). Default 6, clamped to 1-1000.

groups.name: Offline geolocation
groups.description: Optional offline GeoLite2 tier for the admin login overview. Unset, the runtime reads /opt/geolite2 (the path the image bakes its own copy into) and falls back to the online provider when the databases are absent.

variables.name: GEOLITE2_DIR
variables.purpose: Directory holding GeoLite2-City.mmdb + GeoLite2-ASN.mmdb. Point it at a read-only mount to bring your own databases. Default /opt/geolite2.

variables.name: MAXMIND_LICENSE_KEY
variables.purpose: MaxMind licence key for the runtime GeoLite2 fetch (issue #659). Set it and the worker downloads both databases into GEOLITE2_DIR on boot and monthly, no rebuild or manual mount. Free at maxmind.com/en/geolite2/signup.

groups.name: APNs (iOS push)
groups.description: All four core APNS_* vars together. Missing any disables APNs silently — the v1.4.40 AP-2 gap that motivated this manifest. allOrNone trips the synthetic <all-or-none> required row whenever 1-3 of the 4 are set.

variables.name: APNS_KEY_ID
variables.purpose: 10-char Key ID from Apple Developer.

variables.name: APNS_TEAM_ID
variables.purpose: 10-char Team ID from Apple Developer.

variables.name: APNS_BUNDLE_ID
variables.purpose: iOS app bundle id, e.g. dev.healthlog.ios.

variables.name: APNS_KEY
variables.purpose: APNs auth key (.p8 contents). Use APNS_KEY for 12-factor env-block deploys; APNS_KEY_FILE is the filesystem alternative — at least one of the two must be set.

groups.name: Deploy webhook
groups.description: Coolify -> HealthLog deploy-result webhook. Without this, the auto-deploy success/failure feedback loop is broken.

variables.name: DEPLOY_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.purpose: Shared secret for the X-Deploy-Webhook-Secret header on POST /api/internal/deploy-webhook. 64 hex chars.

variables.name: DEPLOY_LOGS_URL
variables.purpose: URL of the deployment dashboard (e.g. the Coolify UI) linked in deploy-failure notifications. Optional; when unset the notification omits the link.

groups.name: TLS leaf pin monitor
groups.description: Baseline for the TLS leaf SPKI-change alarm. The native client pins the served leaf certificate; without this the monitor logs the served pin but cannot alarm on a rotation. See docs/ops/tls-cert-pin.md.

variables.name: TLS_LEAF_SPKI_PINS
variables.purpose: Comma-separated known-good leaf SPKI pins, base64(sha256(DER subjectPublicKeyInfo)) — the same value the native client pins. Hold both the current and the next pin during a dual-pin renewal window.

groups.name: SMTP (email channel)
groups.description: Operator SMTP transport for the email notification channel (v1.17.1). All of SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_FROM together enable the channel; SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASS are optional (unauthenticated relay). Missing any of the three core vars disables email silently — the channel is never offered and the Settings card hides itself.

variables.name: SMTP_HOST
variables.purpose: SMTP server hostname, e.g. smtp.example.com.

variables.name: SMTP_PORT
variables.purpose: SMTP port. 587 for STARTTLS (SMTP_SECURE unset/false), 465 for implicit TLS (SMTP_SECURE=true).

variables.name: SMTP_FROM
variables.purpose: From address for outbound mail, e.g. "HealthLog <noreply@example.com>".

groups.name: Notification targets on a private network
groups.description: Operator grant for webhook (Gotify, Home Assistant, n8n) and ntfy targets on the operator's own network. Unset, a target that resolves to a private address is refused at send time and the test button reports private_origin_not_approved. Optional; public targets never need it.

variables.name: NOTIFICATION_PRIVATE_ORIGINS
variables.purpose: Comma-separated exact origins (scheme://host[:port], no path, no wildcard, no CIDR), e.g. "https://gotify.example.com,http://ntfy.lan:8080". Loopback, link-local and metadata addresses stay refused even when listed; a malformed entry is logged once and grants nothing.

groups.name: Off-host backups
groups.description: Required ALL-OR-NONE: any of these without the rest disables backups silently.

variables.name: BACKUP_S3_ENDPOINT
variables.purpose: S3-compatible endpoint URL.

variables.name: BACKUP_S3_BUCKET
variables.purpose: Bucket name.

variables.name: BACKUP_S3_ACCESS_KEY
variables.purpose: S3 access key.

variables.name: BACKUP_S3_SECRET_KEY
variables.purpose: S3 secret key.

variables.name: BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.purpose: Separate AES key for the backup body — MUST NOT match ENCRYPTION_KEY.

groups.name: Operational windows and cookie flags
groups.description: Values the product states back to a user or that decide whether a session cookie is accepted. Optional: each has a documented default. They are listed so `pnpm check-env` reports them, and so the compose whitelist and the example files can be held in step with this manifest.

variables.name: AUDIT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.purpose: How long audit rows survive, in days (365 by default). Published, not merely enforced: the shared-access activity feed and the dialog that ends somebody's access both state the number back to the user.

variables.name: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE
variables.purpose: Forces the Secure flag on every cookie the app issues. Unset, it tracks NODE_ENV. Set false for a LAN / VPN-only self-host served over plain HTTP, where the default makes login look broken.

variables.name: TRUST_PROXY_HOPS
variables.purpose: Trusted reverse-proxy hop count; the client IP is read that many entries from the right of X-Forwarded-For.
